statistics.title: Focus Statistics
statistics.averageFocusTimeDesc: Your average focus duration, reflecting your focus endurance.
statistics.mostProductiveTimeDesc: You're most efficient during this time. Schedule important tasks then.
statistics.mostProductiveDayDesc: You're most efficient on this day. Consider scheduling important work.
statistics.noDataMessage: Start focusing to see your statistics here!

trends.title: Focus Trends
trends.durationStable: Your focus duration has been stable recently.
trends.durationIncreasing: Your focus duration is increasing. Great job!
trends.durationDecreasing: Your focus duration is decreasing. Try to schedule more focus time.
trends.sessionsStable: Your focus session count has been stable recently.
trends.sessionsIncreasing: You're doing more focus sessions. Keep it up!
trends.sessionsDecreasing: You're doing fewer focus sessions. Try to schedule more.
trends.completionStable: Your completion rate has been stable recently.
trends.completionIncreasing: Your completion rate is improving. Great job!
trends.completionDecreasing: Your completion rate is decreasing. Try shorter sessions or fewer distractions.
trends.notEnoughData: At least 7 days of focus data is needed to show trends.

distribution.title: Focus Distribution
distribution.dailyDistributionDesc: When you focus the most during the day
distribution.weeklyDistributionDesc: Which days you focus the most

heatmap.title: Focus Heatmap
heatmap.description: This heatmap shows when you focus the most during the week. Darker colors indicate more focus sessions.

ratings.title: Focus Ratings
ratings.description: View your focus quality, efficiency, and habit ratings to understand your focus performance.

achievements.title: Focus Achievements
achievements.description: Unlock different focus achievements to make your focus journey more rewarding.
achievements.timeNoviceDesc: Focused for at least 5 hours total
achievements.timeAdeptDesc: Focused for at least 20 hours total
achievements.timeExpertDesc: Focused for at least 50 hours total
achievements.timeMasterDesc: Focused for at least 100 hours total
achievements.timeGrandmasterDesc: Focused for at least 200 hours total
achievements.qualityNoviceDesc: Achieved a focus quality score of at least 60
achievements.qualityAdeptDesc: Achieved a focus quality score of at least 70
achievements.qualityExpertDesc: Achieved a focus quality score of at least 80
achievements.qualityMasterDesc: Achieved a focus quality score of at least 90
achievements.qualityGrandmasterDesc: Achieved a perfect focus quality score of 100

export.title: Export Data
export.description: Export your focus data for backup or analysis in external tools.

goals.title: Focus Goals
goals.description: Set your focus goals, track your progress, and improve your focus efficiency.

suggestions.title: Focus Suggestions
suggestions.description: Get personalized suggestions based on your focus habits and efficiency.
suggestions.notEnoughData: Complete at least 5 focus sessions to get personalized suggestions.
suggestions.lowEfficiency: Your focus completion rate is low. Try shorter focus sessions or eliminate distractions to improve completion rate.
suggestions.mediumEfficiency: You're doing well with completing focus sessions. Keep it up and try to minimize interruptions for even better results.
suggestions.highEfficiency: Excellent focus completion rate! You're very good at maintaining focus during your sessions.
suggestions.lowInterruptions: You have very few interruptions during focus sessions. Great job staying focused!
suggestions.mediumInterruptions: You have some interruptions during focus. Try to identify and eliminate common distractions.
suggestions.highInterruptions: You have frequent interruptions during focus. Consider using Do Not Disturb mode or finding a quieter environment.
suggestions.bestTimeOfDay: You're most productive around {time}. Try to schedule important tasks during this time.
suggestions.bestDayOfWeek: Your most productive day is {day}. Consider planning important work on this day.
